title: Choice criteria are emitted under the wrong key
task_prompt: The request builder now emits choice criteria as `options` instead of `criteria`, so the decision suite fails and the endpoint would reject the request. Restore the contract in both adapters.
intent: a shared request-field name is wrong in both adapters; each implements the same mapping independently

mutations.note: Perplexity emits the wrong field name
ScaleDown has the same defect in a second file

oracle.expected_initial: contract-test fails: choice questions carry no criteria record

history.finding: with selftest:decisions as the oracle, this mutation passed — the decision suite does not assert the request body shape, so it cannot detect a wire-contract change
history.action: oracle replaced by tools/contract-test.js; the mutation itself was not altered and no claim was weakened

gold.known_trap: fixing one adapter leaves the other failing; banks are frozen and must not be edited
